summary: Address code smell: shotgun surgery data locals in ide adapters shared

delivery.outcome: Rename the generic local variable 'data' to stage-accurate names in each of the six functions of src/koru/ide_adapters/shared.py that mutate it: parsed (_read_json_object, the decoded JSON value being validated as a dict), settings (read_socket_from_settings, the parsed settings.json object), workspace_settings (fix_workspace_socket) and user_settings (fix_user_socket, the two settings documents the socket fixers read and rewrite), product_info (vscode_core_version, the parsed product.json core manifest; 'product' is already bound to the config-home Path in that function), entries (extension_listed_in_extensions_json, the parsed extensions.json entry list). The code2llm shotgun-surgery detector groups mutations by (file, variable) and fires at >= 5 scopes; the 'data' group drops from 6 scopes to 0. Each new name lands at 1 scope, so no (file, variable) group grows toward the threshold. Pure rename of function-internal locals; no signature, return shape or behavior change; no other file touched.
nonGoals: No behavior, parsing, validation or interface change
No restructuring into a shared document-decoding abstraction (each function already owns one decode stage; the shared generic name was the defect, not a missing abstraction)

No fix for the pre-existing 'strategy' shotgun-surgery group in the same file (5 scopes, separately ticketed in planfile) or for findings in other files - minimal scope for this ticket's reported smell only
No rename of locals in other files that happen to use 'data' (each is an independent local in its own file scope)

architecture.decision: Stage-accurate local renames only, inside one module. Every function that decodes a document names the decoded payload after the parse stage it serves (parsed JSON validation target, settings.json object, workspace/user settings documents, product.json core manifest, extensions.json entry list); the generic name 'data' disappears from the file's mutation set entirely. Verified with the installed code2llm DFGExtractor mutation grouping on the file's AST (standalone extract, since ProjectAnalyzer.analyze on copies/worktrees silently yields empty scopes): baseline reports a 'data' mutation group of exactly 6 scopes - _read_json_object, read_socket_from_settings, fix_workspace_socket, fix_user_socket, vscode_core_version, extension_listed_in_extensions_json - matching the ticket's 'spans 6 functions'; after the rename the 'data' group is empty, the file mutation record count is unchanged (94) and no new (file, variable) group reaches the >= 5 threshold (the pre-existing 'strategy' group at 5 scopes and 'trusted' at 4 remain untouched).
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; the locals are named data again and the smell report returns.

Renamed content reports a 'data' group of 0 scopes; file mutation record count unchanged at 94 (pure rename); every renamed local lands at 1 scope, far below the >= 5 threshold; the only remaining textual 'data' token is the unrelated '--user-data-dir' IDE flag inside a docstring.
